We conclude that while robotic hydrogen refueling was successfully demonstrated, that the robot as designed worked best in perfect conditions and significant development would be required to adapt the robot to all warehouse conditions and all vehicles. Significant motor power is needed to navigate the nozzle in the plane of the fuel cell receptacle and then insert into the receptacle. Positioning of vehicle relative to dispenser The NREL team first performed experiments to measure the receptacle and vehicle positioning relative to the dispenser. Several measurements were taken on the Toyota Mirai at NREL’s facility. These measurements also included positioning of the vehicle relative to the dispenser for better understanding of the window that the robotic fueler will have to accommodate.
